_comment: Cloud decks. The march sums all enabled layers per step. Layer 0's params are OVERRIDDEN at runtime by the legacy flat knobs (CloudVolume), INCLUDING its per-deck lighting (cumulus defaults) — so phase_g/albedo/tint here on layer 0 are ignored. Layers 1+ are pure data here. Per-deck lighting (roadmap #1): phase_g (forward silver-lining), phase_iso (isotropic blend; cirrus high), albedo (cirrus thin&bright), sun_absorb (cumulus dark-cored; cirrus uniform), tint_r/g/b (cumulus warm, cirrus cool). coverage_weight = this deck's share of the master coverage knob. Disable layer 1 to verify the single-layer regression.

layers._lighting_note: layer 0 lighting is OVERRIDDEN by CloudLayers.WithCumulusLighting — these values are documentation only
